name: Paper map pin
oneLiner: a close shot of a folded paper map on scanned crumpled paper: a brand-colour marker route draws on twos from a ringed start to the goal, a real push pin in the brand colour drops out of the lens and sticks, and both ends get a handwritten label
say: when the speaker lays out where something is heading ('here is the plan', 'from where you are to where you want to be'): the route draws while they explain and the pin sticks on the destination word
